name: sleek-ui
description: a minimal terminal theme extension for Pi: bundled themes, thinking-style animations, a startup logo animation, a theme page background, selectable user-message styles, a subtle agent-message background, split-diff edit blocks, an italic icon-led animated collapsed thinking label, detail-only tool shine with a relaxed 1.6-second minimum visible loop and eased fade-out, collapsed bash commands, uniform one-line Read/Write/Skill blocks, expanded syntax-highlighted code blocks, Sleek density as the default with Extended density available, a live turn timer, an always-shown agent response footer, a focus-aware sound/desktop notification alert with a configurable method, timer and extension prompt blacklist, a 30% toggleable task/session side panel, copy-safe fullscreen message chrome, image-preview blocks below user messages with View/Save-to-Downloads actions, and customizable Sleek/Bar/Minimal status bars and user/agent message styles with a Bar (nvim statusline) variant.
